description: A migrator resource: a service.json with appType migrator is registered with flisk resource, and flisk status lists it as a migrator (openspec task 3.6, #1290). M1 and M2 start no stack. Routed health does not apply: a migrator serves no HTTP route. M3 proves the order on a live stack (#531): flisk up starts Postgres, runs the Prisma migrator to completion, then starts the API. M4 does the same with a database resource (appType database, framework postgres) that the migrator names in dependsOn instead of postgres (#2863).
